title: I don't learn anything on HN anymore, bring back the upvote count
author: wdewind
excerpt: I know 1500 people have said this before, but today I guess I'm the one who hit the boiling point. The value of HN, from the perspective of simply learning, has been destroyed for me since upvotes were hidden. When I first started reading HN I learned a TON very quickly and everyday about completely new stuff, and was able to do so because I could easily sort through the legitimacy of opinions based on their upvotes. guide_zh: 用户认为隐藏赞数降低了学习价值，呼吁恢复显示。

title: Ask HN: How to stave off decline of HN?
author: pg
excerpt: I was just asking RiderofGiraffes if he had any suggestions for fixing the decreasing quality of comment threads on HN (http://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=2403449) and it occurred to me that I might as well ask everyone. Anyone have any suggestions? We're on mostly uncharted territory here. The problem has several components: comments that are (a) mean and/or (b) dumb that (c) get massively upvoted.
